audit_issue: Issue 5: External Validity, Generalization, and Distribution Shift

primary_generalization_hypotheses.metric: Spearman rank correlation (rho) and Quintile ROC-AUC
primary_generalization_hypotheses.statistical_method: Percentile bootstrap (B=10000) for 95% CI; asymptotic t-test p-value
primary_generalization_hypotheses.interpretation_rule: Supported if rho > 0.40 and p < 0.001 and AUC > 0.75

primary_generalization_hypotheses.target_subgroup: Unseen Brands (Zero Pre-Cutoff SKU Footprint, Tier 0 Fallback)
primary_generalization_hypotheses.statistical_method: Percentile bootstrap (B=2000) for 95% CI; comparison against seen brands
primary_generalization_hypotheses.interpretation_rule: Supported if unseen brand rho > 0.30 and p < 0.05, demonstrating non-reliance on brand memorization

primary_generalization_hypotheses.target_subgroup: Specification Completeness Terciles (High vs Medium vs Low)
primary_generalization_hypotheses.metric: Spearman rho monotonically increasing with completeness score
primary_generalization_hypotheses.statistical_method: Predefined tercile thresholds (t33=0.90, t66=1.00) fit on train set before outcome inspection

primary_generalization_hypotheses.metric: Spearman rho in unseen category test products
primary_generalization_hypotheses.statistical_method: Model fit on 4 categories without held-out category data; zero category profile
primary_generalization_hypotheses.interpretation_rule: Supported if mean LOCO rho > 0.25; Falsified if mean LOCO rho <= 0.0

primary_generalization_hypotheses.target_subgroup: Full Temporal Test with Brand Tier Feature Zeroed Out
primary_generalization_hypotheses.statistical_method: Direct feature zeroing of brand_tier in frozen model
primary_generalization_hypotheses.interpretation_rule: Supported if rho_nobrand retains >= 80% of full model rho

exploratory_post_hoc_analyses.description: Post-hoc investigation of physical spec omissions (noise, mold, corrosion) in countertop ice maker manual and specs
exploratory_post_hoc_analyses.caveat: Exploratory root-cause attribution; observational and non-confirmatory

exploratory_post_hoc_analyses.description: Post-hoc attribution of power bank performance drop to GaN / high-wattage USB-C PD 100W market shift post-2021
exploratory_post_hoc_analyses.caveat: Technological shift hypothesis formulated after observing negative temporal correlation in power banks
Horizon 3 has n=11; underpowered to establish formal decay curve slope
